died.name: Karl Dane

died.last_words: To Frances and all my friends-goodbye

born.name: Philip III of Spain
born.last_words: Oh, would to God I had never reigned! Oh, that those years I have spent in my kingdom I had lived a solitary life in the wilderness! Oh, that I had lived alone with God! How much more secure should I now have died! With how much more confidence should I have gone to the throne of God! What doth all my glory profit, but that I have so much the more torment in my death?
